segments.description: A community-oriented bank holding company delivering consumer and commercial banking and wealth management services to customers in a five-state market area.
segments.evidence: The Corporation has one reportable segment whose primary sources of revenue are interest income on loans, investment securities and other interest-earning assets and fee income earned on its products and services.

revenueModel.text: The company earns interest income on loans, investment securities and other interest-earning assets, plus fee income on its banking and wealth management products and services.

changes.text: In 2022, the Corporation completed the acquisition of Prudential Bancorp, whose bank merged into Fulton Bank in November 2022.
